title: Porto met de hele groep
style: 3D game render of blocky toy-like avatars from an online sandbox game: cube-shaped heads, rectangular arms and legs, smooth glossy plastic shading, simple cartoon painted faces, bright saturated colors, sunny city plaza environment built from blocks, game screenshot look, no logos, no watermarks, no text

daan.name: Daan
daan.look: boy avatar wearing a backwards red cap, white t-shirt, blue jeans, holding a smartphone

lotte.name: Lotte
lotte.look: girl avatar with long blonde blocky hair, pink hoodie, white sneakers, very excited expression

sem.name: Sem
sem.look: boy avatar with black sunglasses, green bucket hat, hawaiian shirt, relaxed pose

jayden.name: Jayden
jayden.look: boy avatar with curly dark hair, oversized grey hoodie, nervous face with sweat drops

noor.name: Noor
noor.look: girl avatar with dark hair in two buns, yellow jacket, big optimistic smile

shots.scene: Daan stands on a wooden crate in a blocky city square addressing a big group of friends, the other four avatars and several more blocky friends in front of him, wide shot.
shots.motion: Daan gestures enthusiastically while talking, friends listen

lines.text: Oké jongens. Porto. Met z'n twaalven. Vlucht is negenentachtig euro. Wie gaat er mee?

shots.caption:
PORTO MET
DE HELE GROEP

shots.scene: The whole group of blocky friends jumps in the air cheering with arms up, confetti, low angle.
shots.motion: everyone jumps and cheers with arms raised, camera shakes
shots.caption: 12/12 IN!

shots.scene: Close-up of Daan smiling confidently, holding up his smartphone showing a flight booking screen.
shots.motion: Daan talks to camera and holds up phone

lines.text: Top. Stuur me dan allemaal even negenentachtig euro.

shots.scene: The group of blocky friends goes completely silent, everyone slowly looks away awkwardly, a tumbleweed rolls by.
shots.motion: everyone slowly turns their heads away awkwardly, very still

shots.scene: Close-up of Jayden sweating heavily, nervous awkward smile.

lines.text: Bro... kan ik je in mei terugbetalen?

shots.scene: Close-up of Noor holding up an empty wallet with a moth flying out, still smiling.
shots.motion: Noor talks cheerfully and shows the empty wallet

lines.text: Ik heb nog vier euro twintig. En drie openstaande Tikkies.

shots.caption: saldo: €4,20

shots.scene: Close-up of Sem with sunglasses, hand on heart, dramatic sunset lighting.
shots.motion: Sem talks dramatically with hand on heart

lines.text: Mijn bank zegt nee. Maar mijn hart zegt Porto.

shots.scene: Close-up of Daan staring at his phone in shock, jaw dropped, phone screen shows a price of 249 euro.
shots.motion: Daan refreshes his phone and his jaw drops in shock

lines.text: Eh... hij is nu tweehonderdnegenenveertig euro.

shots.caption: NU: €249

shots.scene: All five blocky friends sprint full speed through the blocky city streets towards their part-time jobs, wearing work aprons, dynamic action shot.
shots.motion: everyone sprints at full speed toward the camera, arms pumping, dust clouds
shots.caption: HUSS HUSS HUSS

shots.scene: Inside a blocky cartoon airplane cabin, all five friends sit in seats wearing sunglasses, a game-style UI loading bar says nothing, they look satisfied.
shots.motion: friends lean back relaxed in their airplane seats, plane shakes slightly

lines.text: Nieuw plan. We gaan naar Porto... in de game.

shots.caption:
PORTO 2027
(misschien)
